faq.hero.title: Frequently asked questions
faq.hero.subtitle: The most common questions before requesting a quote. If you can't find yours, ask directly on WhatsApp.
faq.q1.a: A free first technical visit, at your home or business. From there you get a fixed quote with three options — Basic, Smart and Complete — for you to choose, with no obligation and no small print.
faq.q2.q: What is the Central AI Mini-PC and why is it mandatory?
faq.q2.a: It's the brain behind every mode of the Predictive AI Platform: it analyzes your cameras and sensors and coordinates the whole system. It's mandatory because standalone modes with their own hardware are no longer installed — they all share this same brain. There are two tiers: AI START (€590, for 1-2 modes) and AI PRO (€950, for 3 or more modes, or AI Security with several cameras at once).
faq.q3.q: Do I have to pay a monthly fee?
faq.q3.a: No. All the analysis happens locally, on your own mini-PC, without relying on an external server or an alarm monitoring center. You pay for the installation once and the system is yours, with no fees afterward.
faq.q4.q: How does AI Security avoid false alarms?
faq.q4.a: The system doesn't just record: it analyzes each camera with AI and learns to tell real people and vehicles apart from false alarms — a cat, a shadow, a bag moving in the wind. It only alerts you on WhatsApp, with a photo, when it really matters.
faq.q5.q: What areas do you work in?
faq.q6.q: How long does an installation take?
faq.q6.a: It depends on the service: from a quick couple-hour job (a lock, a few outlets) to a full day for larger installations. The exact time is confirmed during the technical visit.
faq.q7.q: What warranty do the installations have?
faq.q7.a: Every AHOMED installation comes with a warranty, using materials from leading brands, and the equipment is yours from day one.
faq.q8.q: Can I start with just the basics and add AI later?
faq.q8.a: Yes. Many basic services — cameras, locks, networks — can be expanded later with any mode from the Predictive AI Platform, without redoing the original installation.
faq.q9.q: Do you also work with warehouses, industrial units or rural properties, or only homes?
faq.q9.a: Both. Warehouses & Properties has its own section in the menu, with basic services, AI Security at perimeter/industrial scale, and the AI Security Pack for Businesses.
faq.q10.q: How do I request a quote?
faq.q10.a: Via WhatsApp — it's the fastest and most direct way. The first technical visit is free with no obligation.

profesionales.hero.body: Collaborate with AHOMED if you're a renovator, builder, blinds installer, electrician or interior designer. We add AI security, home automation, networks and energy to your projects — without you having to learn it or sell it yourself.
profesionales.launch.title: Your first collaboration with AHOMED, 30% off
profesionales.launch.body: We're just starting out, and we'd rather prove it with actions than words. For the first 3 companies or professionals who collaborate with us, we'll apply a 30% discount to the technology side of the first project — you keep 100% of what you invoice for your part. In exchange, we just ask to photograph and film the result, and a review if it went well.
profesionales.launch.fine_print: Applies to a standard-sized project (one home or business); for larger projects we discuss it case by case. Valid while spots remain of the 3 available.
profesionales.launch.cta: I want to be one of the 3 →
profesionales.why.title: I don't want to compete with you. I want to help you sell more.
profesionales.why.body: Many renovators, builders and installers know how to do kitchens, bathrooms, drywall, painting or blinds — but they don't master AI, smart cameras, automation or integration. You do the build. AHOMED adds the smart part.
profesionales.why.card1.title: Increase the value of every job
profesionales.why.card1.body: Renovation + smart lighting + motorized blinds + AI security = "renovation + smart home". You sell more to the same client without installing the technology yourself — we sort out the financial details in the sales conversation.
profesionales.why.card2.title: It doesn't add work for you
profesionales.why.card2.body: You introduce us to the client. We handle the visit, the proposal, the quote and the installation of the technology side. You simply made the introduction.
profesionales.why.card3.title: You step in at the perfect moment
profesionales.why.card3.body: While the home is under construction is when it makes sense to run cabling, home automation, cameras and networks — before walls and floors are closed up.
profesionales.modelos.title: Three ways to collaborate
profesionales.modelos.body: It's not all or nothing. Choose the model that best fits your business — or combine them.
profesionales.modelos.item1.title: 1. Commission per referred client
profesionales.modelos.item1.body: You introduce us to a client and, if the project goes ahead, you receive a commission on our margin or a fixed amount per closed project. The simplest way to start.
profesionales.modelos.item2.title: 2. You sell more on your own job
profesionales.modelos.item2.body: You add our technology side to your quote and present it as "renovation + smart home". You earn more from the same client, without installing the technology yourself.
profesionales.modelos.item3.title: 3. We handle the part you don't master
profesionales.modelos.item3.body: You do kitchens, bathrooms, drywall or blinds. We add AI, smart cameras, automation, networks and integration. You position yourself as more complete, without training in technology.
profesionales.aporta.title: What AHOMED brings to your project
profesionales.aporta.body: We handle the smart layer that most construction professionals don't offer: AI security, home automation, networks, energy and automation — with a selection of technology and solutions suited to each project, with no monthly fees for the end client.
profesionales.aporta.li1: AI Security: cameras, detection, video intercom, WhatsApp alerts
profesionales.aporta.li2: Home automation: lights, blinds, climate control, scenes
profesionales.aporta.li3: Predictive AI Platform: presence, sleep, pets, elderly, children
profesionales.aporta.li4: Networks: professional WiFi, infrastructure for cameras and home automation
profesionales.aporta.li5: Smart energy: solar, consumption, climate control, charging
profesionales.aporta.li6: AHOMED Brain: the technology core behind it all
profesionales.niveles.title: AHOMED for Professionals, at a glance
profesionales.niveles.body: It's this simple to present to your client: four levels, without you having to explain the technology.
profesionales.niveles.item1.title: Renovation + smart lighting
profesionales.niveles.item1.body: The simplest entry point: app-based light control and basic scenes.
profesionales.niveles.item2.title: Renovation + home automation
profesionales.niveles.item2.body: Lights, blinds and climate control coordinated, with control from your phone.
profesionales.niveles.item3.title: Renovation + AI security
profesionales.niveles.item3.body: Cameras with smart detection and WhatsApp alerts — no false alarms.
profesionales.niveles.item4.title: Renovation + full smart home
profesionales.niveles.item4.body: Security, home automation, networks and energy integrated under the AHOMED Brain.
profesionales.niveles.note: We prepare the quote for the technology side. You don't need to know how to explain the AI — you just say: "We have an AHOMED solution for this part".

profesionales.piloto.body: The easiest way to start collaborating, before discussing any formal agreement.
profesionales.piloto.item1.title: 1. You introduce us to a client
profesionales.piloto.item1.body: You spot the opportunity in a job you already have underway.
profesionales.piloto.item2.title: 2. We do the visit and the proposal
profesionales.piloto.item2.body: We study the project and prepare a quote for the technology side.
profesionales.piloto.item3.title: 3. We coordinate and integrate the installation
profesionales.piloto.item3.body: We coordinate the construction side with your team and add the smart layer.
profesionales.piloto.item4.title: 4. If it goes well, we make it ongoing
profesionales.piloto.item4.body: We turn the pilot into a stable collaboration, with the model that fits best.

tecnologia.hero.title: The technology behind your home
tecnologia.hero.subtitle: You don't need to understand servers or AI models to order it — but if you're curious, here's what we install.
tecnologia.card_cerebro.title: AHOMED Brain
tecnologia.card_cerebro.text: A single Central AI Mini-PC, in two tiers depending on how many modes you need (IA START and IA PRO), that connects and coordinates every service on the Predictive AI Platform.
tecnologia.card_local.title: AI on-site, not in the cloud
tecnologia.card_local.text: Analysis runs on your own mini-PC, on one frame every 1-2 seconds — not continuous streaming out. The decision happens in your home.
tecnologia.card_video.title: Video processing
tecnologia.card_video.text: Tells real people and vehicles apart from false alarms — a cat, a shadow, a bag moving in the wind — before alerting you.
tecnologia.card_video.detail: Technical detail: YOLO26 vision models trained for that distinction.
tecnologia.card_automatizacion.title: Automation
tecnologia.card_automatizacion.text: A Python engine cross-references data nobody else combines: weather, hourly electricity price, geolocation, air quality and sleep phases, to decide what to do.
tecnologia.card_dashboard.title: Dashboard
tecnologia.card_dashboard.text: A unified control panel with camera status, alerts, weather and access in one place — to check whenever you want, not because you have to.
tecnologia.card_whatsapp.title: WhatsApp Business API
tecnologia.card_whatsapp.text: Alerts arrive straight to WhatsApp, with a photo of the moment, only when it truly matters — no extra apps to install to receive them.
tecnologia.card_integraciones.title: Integrations
tecnologia.card_integraciones.text: Compatible with widely used WiFi and Zigbee devices (Shelly or equivalents) and with locks or garage motors you already have installed.
tecnologia.card_sin_cuotas.title: No fees, no third parties
tecnologia.card_sin_cuotas.text: No dependence on an external server or a third-party alarm monitoring center. You pay for the installation once and the equipment is yours, with no monthly fee.
tecnologia.modos.title: How many modes do you need?
tecnologia.modos.text: The AHOMED Brain tier (IA START or IA PRO) depends on how many AI services you want running at once, not on the size of your home.

sobre_mi.hero.title: About me
sobre_mi.hero.subtitle: Over 10 years of multidisciplinary technical experience: from software development and artificial intelligence to electrical installation, home automation and security systems, with field work in demanding environments.
sobre_mi.hero.photo_alt: Ahmed, technician and founder of AHOMED
sobre_mi.experiencia.title: My experience
sobre_mi.experiencia.p1: I'm a multidisciplinary technician specializing in electrical work, home automation, networking, security and artificial intelligence systems applied to homes and businesses. For over a decade I've combined software development with on-site installation and maintenance: electrical panels, home networks, cameras and sensors, AI detection systems, and full home automation.
sobre_mi.experiencia.p2: That technical foundation is what sets AHOMED apart: I don't just install cameras or home automation, I also know how to configure and train the AI models behind them. I've spent years building AI video surveillance systems for an industry where a false alarm has a real cost — industrial installations monitored 24/7, with combined camera, GPS and sensor detection. I apply that same experience so your security system can truly tell a person apart from a cat or a shadow, and only alert you when it matters.
